summary.intent: Fix review findings across several open PRs (type resolver, panic diagnostics, Windows paths, config handling, missing-TypeScript diagnostics) by delegating to a subagent, then verify the pushes and CI.
summary.outcome: All six fix PRs (#335, #345, #350, #359, #349, #352, #360) were pushed after passing lint and crate tests. CI showed one real failure, the Linux NAPI job on #349, and a worker was spawned to fix it. The pending CI runs were not yet confirmed green.

repo: The pre-push gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`, plus the crate's own tests.
Nine known path-artifact test failures exist in this environment; they are expected noise and did not appear in the final runs.
Other worktrees hold the real branch names, so the subagent worked on local branches `w<n>` and pushed with `git push origin HEAD:<branch>`.
`node_modules` is a symlink and must not be committed.
`PropType::Tuple` is part of the wire format. Adding an optionality flag would change it, so optional tuple elements are modelled as `T | undefined`.
Alias-parameter shadowing and `in_scope_type_params` scoping are coupled across PRs. Applying the tuple shadowing fix without #335's scoping fix would break `Id<Value>`, so #345 merges #335.
The 260-character Windows path limit must be measured on the plain spelling, not the verbatim-prefixed one. The prefix adds 4 characters for a drive path and 6 for a UNC path.
`in_node_modules` is `pub(crate)` and handles both path separators. `collapses` should use it instead of checking only `/node_modules/`.

The new missing-`typescript` warning is suspected of breaking NAPI tests that build temp projects without TypeScript. The tests pass locally on macOS, probably because `typescript` resolves from a parent directory, but fail on the Linux CI job.

code.finding: The lazy request loop never terminated after a loader panic, because a demand whose load panicked stays missing and keeps being requested. It now stops when a load leaves the same names missing.
The 260-character limit check is now applied to the plain spelling, so 256–259 character paths drop the verbatim prefix.
Merging #335 into #345 conflicted only here; both sides' tests were kept.
#360 conflicted with #352 here and in config/tests.rs. The merge rebases both `cacheDir` and `tscPath` against the config's folder.

workflow: Check CI directly instead of trusting a subagent's self-report. Doing so caught the #349 NAPI failure that the subagent's local runs missed.
Failed CI job logs are unavailable until the whole run finishes. Job annotations can serve as a fallback to find the failing step.
Write tests first and confirm they fail before the fix. The #359 length test was not run against the old code, which weakens its evidence.
When stacked or overlapping PRs depend on each other's fixes, merge the dependency branch in and note how the diff shrinks once the base lands.
Jobs added on one platform, such as the Linux NAPI job, can expose environment-dependent assumptions that only appear in CI.

friction: The NAPI job log could not be read while the run was in progress, so the cause of the failure had to be hypothesized.
Branch names are held by other worktrees, which forced local `w<n>` branches and `HEAD:<branch>` pushes.
Nine path-artifact test failures exist in this environment and have to be told apart from real failures.
Overlapping PRs (#335/#345 and #352/#360) produced merge conflicts and coupling that had to be resolved by hand.
About 15 PRs still had CI running, so the final state could not be confirmed.
open_items: Confirm the #349 NAPI fix is pushed, passes the full gate, and that no other open PR with that job is at risk.
Wait for the pending CI runs to finish green.
Decide on the 13 finding dismissals, which the subagent did not attempt.
Remove or decide on the stray `fix/discover-extensions-and-ignore` branch on origin.
Check whether a release is in flight before merging #329, which edits `callisto-release.yml`.
Check #349 for conflicts against #350 and #359, which was not done.
The CSS length list is only documented as a deliberate subset; the full list was not derived.
The single run-wide missing-TypeScript warning was left unchanged.
